sections.Profile:
"Saturn" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Nordamatic in 1977. Designed for single-player action, it features two flippers, two pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, three standup targets, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Nordamatic
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Space, Original Theme, 1970s, Sci-Fi
